first.rationale: Test a shortened, lower-friction onboarding flow for self-serve SMB accounts. It directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value, early adoption, and first-week activation—more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than broad price competition. Verify the underlying onboarding and signup records before committing, since current declines may have different causes than prior tests.

final.rationale: Run a simplified onboarding experiment for self-serve SMB accounts. Verified evidence directly supports this: shortened onboarding raised completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%. It addresses the current onboarding-completion and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Monitor activation, qualified revenue, and retention guardrails because adjacent signup simplification increased acquisition and activation but reduced 30-day retention by 1%.
